k8s.podsNotReady.expr: (sum(kube_pod_status_ready{condition="false",cluster="k8s-prod"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running",cluster="k8s-prod"}) + (count(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown",cluster="k8s-prod"} == 1) or vector(0))) or vector(0)

pve.guestsUp.expr: (count((max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) and on (id) pve_guest_info{template="0"}) == 1)) or vector(0)

pve.guestsDown.expr: (count((max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) and on (id) pve_guest_info{template="0"}) == 0)) or vector(0)

pve.guestUp.expr: max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_up) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))

pve.guestCpu.expr: 100 * max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))

pve.guestMem.expr: clamp_max(100 * max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})) / max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})), 100)

pve.guestUptime.expr: max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_uptime_seconds) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))

pve.pools.expr: sort_desc(100 * max by (node, storage) (label_mismatch(max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} / (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} > 0)) * on (id) group_left(storage, node, plugintype) max by (id, storage, node, plugintype) (pve_storage_info), "plugintype", "nfs")) or label_set(100 * max by (storage) (label_match(max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} / (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} > 0)) * on (id) group_left(storage, node, plugintype) max by (id, storage, node, plugintype) (pve_storage_info), "plugintype", "nfs")), "node", "shared"))

net.availability.expr: min by (wan) (unpoller_device_wan_monitor_availability_percent{job="unifi-api"} * on (wan_networkgroup) group_left (wan) (max by (wan_networkgroup, wan) (label_replace(unpoller_wan_interface_state{job="unifi-api"}, "wan", "$1", "wan_interface", "(.*)")) * 0 + 1))

ups.onBattery.expr: (max by (ups) (network_ups_tools_ups_status{flag="OB"}) or max by (ups) (label_set(label_match(upsInfoStatus, "upsInfoStatus", "(.* )?OB( .*)?") or upsInfoStatus * 0, "ups", "network-rack")))

net.latency.expr: avg by (wan) (unpoller_device_wan_monitor_latency_average_seconds{job="unifi-api"} * on (wan_networkgroup) group_left (wan) (max by (wan_networkgroup, wan) (label_replace(unpoller_wan_interface_state{job="unifi-api"}, "wan", "$1", "wan_interface", "(.*)")) * 0 + 1))
